# AbstractFlow

> AbstractFlow is the web visual workflow editor for AbstractFramework, distributed as the npm package `@abstractframework/flow`. It serves a browser editor and a small Node server that forwards `/api/*` to AbstractGateway; the same server runs on its own at `/` (127.0.0.1:3003) or behind the Gateway at `/apps/flow/`.

Do not assume a Python package, FastAPI backend, or local execution host exists in AbstractFlow. Execution, provider configuration, user auth, workflow persistence, runs, ledgers, artifacts, and runtime isolation are owned by AbstractGateway and AbstractRuntime.

Repository map: `src/` (React/Vite editor), `bin/cli.js` + `bin/flags.js` (CLI, launch flags, Gateway URL resolution), `bin/server.js` (static server, base path, Gateway session proxy on `@abstractframework/app-server`), `examples/flows/` (sample and shipped VisualFlow JSON), `scripts/` (workflow generators and doc generators), `docs/`.

Key behavior:

- Gateway is the only execution boundary. Flow may capture browser-local files or microphone audio, but uploads them to Gateway as artifacts before start/resume.
- The Flow server sets `X-Forwarded-For` (the browser's address) and `X-AbstractFramework-App-Proxy: abstractflow` on every Gateway-bound request and drops browser-supplied forwarding headers. Every response carries `X-AbstractFramework-App: flow; mount=1`; the editor uses relative URLs only, so it works at `/` and under `/apps/flow/`.
- A workflow's `interfaces` list declares the contracts it implements. Declaring an interface adds its typed pins to `On Flow Start` / `On Flow End`; opening a workflow adds missing pins and shows unsaved changes; Run preflight warns about missing, unconnected, or mistyped interface pins. Eight interfaces carry pin contracts, no two the same, including `abstractcode.agent.v1`, `abstractassistant.agent.v1` (with optional per-modality provider/model pins) and `abstractcode.goal.v1`.
- Opening or importing a workflow keeps every stored connection. Connections the canvas cannot draw are kept, saved, and listed in an "N hidden" node badge; only connections to missing nodes are removed, with a notice.
- A runnable workflow can store `automation_defaults` (trigger source and settings, context mode, title, default `input_data`) in Flow Library > Automation. Trigger sources are discovered from the Gateway (`GET /api/gateway/trigger-sources`, or the path in `contracts.common.automations.trigger_sources_endpoint`); settings are validated against the source's `config_schema` with a JSON Schema subset; a setting whose schema uses another keyword is a JSON field of its own, checked by the Gateway, and never blocks the trigger. Publish exports the field as `metadata.automation_defaults[<flow id>]`; Gateway fills a creation request's missing trigger, context, title and `input_data` from it. Automations are created in AbstractObserver or the Assistant. Sources with `needs_connection` (feeds, webhooks) bind one of the person's trigger connections (`GET /api/gateway/triggers/connections`, created on the Gateway console's Triggers page) as `trigger.connection_id`. An email trigger (`connection_provider: email_accounts`) reads one of the person's mailboxes, named in its settings (`account`).
- A workflow is triggerable when its `On Flow Start` declares the `event` output (type object): a run an automation starts receives `input_data.event`, a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope; feeds and webhooks deliver a batch (`data.count`, `data.events[i].data`), schedules `data.series`. *Add trigger event* adds that output and a "Trigger event" Break Object exposing `type`, `subject`, `time`, `data`, `count`, `events`, `series`.
- Automations in human words: New Flow asks *What starts it?* (a person in a chat, a mailbox saved as `trigger.config.account`, a feed/webhook saved as `trigger.connection_id`, Run now only; never a schedule: a schedule is a property of the automation, set in Observer or the Assistant, and a schedule saved by an older flow is kept and shown in words) and the Flow Library sorts flows by that answer (Chat, Triggered, Other); a triggered flow opens with only On Flow Start (what arrives as typed pins: messages/mailbox, items/feed, calls, scheduled_at/occurrence, plus event) and On Flow End, which records the outcome (response, success, note) and reaches nobody; no node is added; the Automation dialog (header badge, Flow Library > Automation…) edits what starts it, the context (`growing.max_tokens`, default read from `GET /api/gateway/automations/defaults`) and the flow's own inputs, and Turn it on publishes and creates the automation; Run on a triggered flow is a test run on a sample (POST /api/gateway/triggers/sample, src/utils/triggerSample.ts); Mail and publish nodes (mail_search/get/mark/label/move/delete/send/reply/forward/attachment, publish_event; Email pin type; src/utils/emailType.ts, mailNodes.ts) (src/utils/automationChoice.ts, automationPicker.ts, automationInputs.ts, components/automation/).
- After the run (framework ADR-0041): nothing acts after On Flow End. **Notify me** (a `publish_event` node on the `me` channel; **Where** saved in `effectConfig.channels`: tray, watch, phone, email; absent = every channel) is the node that reaches the person; an older flow's `notify` pin on On Flow End still raises an alert. The run window's last section reads `GET /api/gateway/runs/{run_id}/after`: what arrived, the note, the alert and its source, each delivery, or why nothing rang (src/utils/afterTheRun.ts).
- Editor address parameters: `?bundle=…[&version=…][&flow=…]` opens a Gateway workflow; `?trigger=<connection id>` or `?trigger=mail:<mailbox id>` opens New flow on that trigger once the lists loaded; `?flow=<flow id>` opens a Flow library flow (src/utils/bundleDeepLink.ts, triggerDeepLink.ts, flowDeepLink.ts).
- Loading states (ADR-0039): Gateway reads are tried three times (1 s, 3 s) on a timeout, lost connection, 5xx, 408 or 429 (src/utils/readRetry.ts); a spinner shows until a read answered, the reason and Retry only after every try failed; writes are sent once.
- Waits: **Wait Until** (`on_schedule`), **Wait for Event** (`on_event`, or `wait_event` in its step form), **Emit Event** and **Delay** (`wait_until`) pause a running flow; they never start a flow and are not how automations are scheduled. Node types are unchanged from the earlier names On Schedule, On Event and Wait Event.
- A loop body that reaches On Flow End stops after its first item: the save notice and run checks say so and **Fix the loop** wires `done` to On Flow End instead (src/utils/loopEndsRun.ts). Toolbar: New (C), Open (O), Save (Ctrl/⌘+S); folded nodes draw only their wired pins.
- The About dialog is the shared ui-kit compact card: the AbstractFlow version, the AbstractFramework and AbstractGateway versions from `GET /api/gateway/about`, links and the licence line (no package list). Audio artifacts play in the ui-kit waveform player (`AfAudioPlayer`); see docs/architecture.md "Audio Previews".
- Unconnected LLM Call and Agent `resp_schema` pins can be edited inline; schema-active nodes expose structured output on `data` while `response` stays textual.
- Agent and LLM Call nodes expose an MTP depth setting and a `speculation` pin. Precedence: connected pin, node setting, host default (no run-level override).

## Core Docs

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, install, and feature summary
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): start a Gateway, run the editor, sign in, local development
- [docs/web-editor.md](docs/web-editor.md): editor features, sign-in, links into the editor (`?bundle`, `?trigger`, `?flow`), loading and errors, About, node palette and canvas cards (category colours and legend, run status icons, tap vs drag, folded nodes), responsive layout (phones, tablets, tap-to-add, collapsible lists), switches, the Flow Library and kinds of flows, the toolbar (New, Open, Save, C and O), interfaces, automations (New Flow "What starts it?", the Automation dialog, Turn it on, Run as if triggered), Waits, what happens after On Flow End (Notify me and its channels, After the run), trigger-source discovery, trigger connections and the trigger event, mail (the Email type, mail nodes, Break Email), Publish to channel, the wire-drop menu (Relay, If/Else, Break Object, Break Email, ForEach), a loop whose body ends the run (Fix the loop), hidden connections, authoring assistant, media and file nodes
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components, boundaries, and diagrams, including automation defaults, After the run (ADR-0041) and read retries (ADR-0039)
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): CLI options, environment variables, editor address parameters, proxy contract and Gateway routes, frontend modules
- [docs/visualflow.md](docs/visualflow.md): VisualFlow JSON format, interfaces and their boundary pins, `automation_defaults` (with `trigger.connection_id`), the trigger event with one example per source, On Flow End's outcome pins and how Notify me is stored, pin expressions
- [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md): the `abstractflow-editor` command
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): short answers about scope and behavior
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): sign-in, proxy, editor, automation dialog, triggered flows, links and notifications (After the run), plain-http (voice, copy), and build symptoms with fixes

## Source Entry Points

- [src/utils/gatewayClient.ts](src/utils/gatewayClient.ts): Gateway HTTP/SSE client
- [src/utils/gatewayCatalog.ts](src/utils/gatewayCatalog.ts): provider/model/media catalog normalization
- [src/utils/flowFamilies.ts](src/utils/flowFamilies.ts): known interfaces and their typed boundary pins
- [src/utils/preflight.ts](src/utils/preflight.ts): Run preflight checks
- [src/hooks/useFlow.ts](src/hooks/useFlow.ts): editor store and `loadFlow`
- [src/utils/triggerSources.ts](src/utils/triggerSources.ts): trigger-source discovery
- [src/utils/triggerBindings.ts](src/utils/triggerBindings.ts): `automation_defaults` shape and trigger-settings validation
- [src/utils/triggerConnections.ts](src/utils/triggerConnections.ts): trigger connections client and console link
- [src/utils/triggerEvent.ts](src/utils/triggerEvent.ts): trigger event schema, triggerable check, Add trigger event
- [src/components/AutomationDefaultsModal.tsx](src/components/AutomationDefaultsModal.tsx): Flow Library Automation dialog
- [src/components/RunFlowModal.tsx](src/components/RunFlowModal.tsx): run modal (Run as if triggered, After the run)
- [src/utils/afterTheRun.ts](src/utils/afterTheRun.ts): After the run and Notify me's channels
- [src/utils/readRetry.ts](src/utils/readRetry.ts): the read retry policy
- [src/utils/triggerPins.ts](src/utils/triggerPins.ts): what arrives on On Flow Start and On Flow End's outcome pins
- [src/components/GatewayConnectionModal.tsx](src/components/GatewayConnectionModal.tsx): sign-in
- [src/types/nodes.ts](src/types/nodes.ts): node templates
